metadata.title: When you shoot at air and somehow get a kill? Valorant please explain
metadata.description:
Wait, I wasn’t even trying!
The enemy must’ve been handing out gifts today.
Click if your kills come from pure chaos and confusion.
Valorant’s logic never fails to surprise.

Hit that like if you deserve zero credit for that kill!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
